pages.title: Gingerbread House Coloring Page
pages.description: A gingerbread house fills this printable coloring page, with a heart on its arched door, candy canes beside the steps, and gumdrops along the roof ridge.

pages.title: Easy Gingerbread House Coloring Page
pages.description: Three round peppermint swirls top the easy gingerbread house on this printable coloring page, above a wide icing band and two simple four-pane windows.

pages.title: Blank Gingerbread House Outline Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page leaves the gingerbread house outline blank, with two square windows, an arched doorway, and a broad pointed roof edged in scalloped icing.

pages.title: Christmas Gingerbread House with a Wreath Coloring Page
pages.description: A bow-topped wreath hangs on the Christmas gingerbread house in this printable coloring page, between holly sprigs above an arched door decorated with a heart.

pages.title: Cute Gingerbread House with a Smiling Face Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute gingerbread house smiles on this printable coloring page, with two arched windows for eyes, a peppermint roof topper, and little cookies beside the door.

pages.title: Detailed Gingerbread House Coloring Page
pages.description: Icing scrolls, scalloped window frames, and a striped chimney cover the detailed gingerbread house on this printable coloring page, leaving many small sections to color.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man and His House Coloring Page
pages.description: A gingerbread man waves beside his house on this printable coloring page, wearing a bow tie next to the porch steps and heart-decorated front door.

pages.title: Gingerbread Village Coloring Page

pages.title: Candy Cane Gingerbread House Coloring Page

pages.title: Gingerbread Family Outside Their House Coloring Page

pages.title: Gingerbread House and Christmas Tree Coloring Page

pages.title: Inside a Gingerbread House Coloring Page

pages.title: Gingerbread House with a Candy Fence Coloring Page

pages.title: Gingerbread House Christmas Ornament Coloring Page

pages.title: Gingerbread House on a Mug Coloring Page
